about: Country stamps for the World passport, approved batch by batch on the World Review Country Stamps page (style and plan: ex-pass-country). Each symbol is 14 x 14 rows of 'k' (ink) and '.' (clear).

style.postmark: 56 x 44 pt: outer rounded rect x 2.5, y 2.5, 51 x 39, radius 5, stroke 2; inner frame x 6, y 6, 44 x 25, radius 3, stroke 0.8; both in the stamp's ink, no fill.
style.symbol: 14 x 14 pixels centred at x 28, y 18.5, each pixel min(21 / 14, 2.2) = 1.5 pt. About 7 % of ink pixels are left out, chosen by a seeded generator from the country code, so each stamp looks worn in its own way.
style.face: DM Sans Bold, the stamp book's label face (owner approved it over pixel capitals, Country Stamps page st-face, 2026-10-29). Labels use only characters DM Sans Bold has: it has Ə, not Ệ, Ơ or Ư.
style.name: DM Sans Bold capitals in the stamp's ink, centred at x 28, letter-spacing 0.15. Size: the smaller of 5.6 pt (one line) or 4.6 pt (two lines) and 44 / (0.7 x the longest line's letter count). One line: baseline 38.6. Two lines: baselines 35.3 and 39.7.
style.ink: One of four inks, #2F6FA3, #B3343A, #2E8B57, #7B4BA8, picked by (first code letter + second code letter) mod 4. Dark mode lightens it 38 % toward white.
style.tilt: -6 to +6 degrees, from the same seed.
style.notEarned: A dashed rounded rect with a '?' and no name.
style.names: The country's own name in Latin letters (MÉXICO, PANAMÁ, AZƏRBAYCAN); English where its script isn't Latin (JAPAN); VIET NAM because the face has no Ệ.
